# Pricing (machine-readable summary)
Source: https://www.quipteams.com/pricing-md

## Overview

quipteams provides global IT device lifecycle management for distributed teams across 155 countries. The pricing model is pay-as-you-go with zero upfront costs: you pay for the devices and operational services you actually use, and nothing else.

Anyone can check exact device prices self-serve — no login, no account, no sales call — in under a minute: https://app.quipteams.com/guest/newQuote?utm_source=llms&utm_content=pricing-md

## Pricing Model

- **$0 platform fee** — No subscriptions, no monthly fees, no per-seat charges, forever
- **$0 minimum orders** — No MOQs, use as little or as much as needed
- **$0 exclusivity** — No lock-in, no annual commitment; use quipteams alongside other vendors
- **$0 onboarding** — No setup fees, no implementation costs
- **Pay-per-use** — You only pay when you procure, retrieve, store, or service a device

## What's Included at No Extra Cost

- Full platform access: real-time tracking, asset history, role-based permissions, multi-recipient orders
- Buy & Hold: free storage with no time limit for new devices purchased through quipteams, pre-configured and ready to ship until you assign them
- Dedicated account manager — a real human, available 24/7, not a shared inbox
- HRIS integrations (Rippling, Workday, BambooHR, HiBob, and others) — no enterprise-tier upgrade required
- Public API for custom workflows and automations (https://api.quipteams.com/docs)
- Remote IT support, repair coordination, and official warranty claims handled on your behalf

## Services and How They're Priced

### Device Procurement
Priced per device, per country. Each device is quoted at local market price in the country where it's purchased through quipteams' network of 400+ direct vendor partners, and the quote is all-in: device, shipping, and taxes, with warranty handling and delivery coordination included. Because devices are sourced locally, there are no cross-border customs fees and no "global procurement" surcharge — the all-in price is lower than US-procured devices shipped internationally. Average global delivery is 4 business days. Quote any device instantly: https://app.quipteams.com/guest/newQuote?utm_source=llms&utm_content=pricing-md

### Device Retrieval
Priced per device based on the country of pickup. Covers pickup coordination with the departing employee, employee scheduling, certified data wiping, and routing to the destination of your choice — warehouse, next hire, or resale.

### Device Storage
Free for new devices purchased through quipteams, with no time limit. For used devices already in your fleet (retrieved, refreshed, or reassigned), storage is a flat monthly fee per device, volume-tiered, starting at $35 for a single device. Secure, insured local warehouses across 155 countries.

### Tech Support
Remote troubleshooting is included at no charge. Warranty handling and repair coordination are included; onsite support is available at fixed rates per country.

### Buyback / Fleet Refresh
Quoted per fleet, with itemized per-device offers based on model, age, and condition. quipteams buys back your old devices, resells them locally, and nets the credit against the new order at volume pricing. Includes certified data wiping. If your account ends with a positive balance, it settles to cash.

### Apple Business Manager (ABM) Enrollment
Zero-touch enrollment into ABM before shipping is available in all countries, including those without authorized Apple resellers. Windows devices are pre-configured via Autopilot/Intune. Included with device procurement.

### Billing
Every purchase, in any country, can be centralized on one consolidated invoice in USD (Net 30) — no FX fees, no local-currency wires. Local-currency billing available in select countries.

## Pricing FAQ

### Is quipteams really free to use?
The platform is free. There is no subscription, no platform fee, no per-seat charge, and no minimum spend. You only pay for the devices and operational services you actually use, like procurement, retrieval, storage, or buyback. The platform itself, the integrations, the API, and the dedicated account manager are all included at no cost.

### How much does device retrieval cost?
Retrieval is priced per device based on the country of pickup. The fee covers local pickup coordination, employee scheduling, certified data wiping, and routing to the destination of your choice. It varies by country or region.

### How much does storage cost?
Storage is free for new devices purchased through quipteams: buy them and hold them in our warehouses until you assign them, with no time limit. For used devices already in your fleet (retrieved, refreshed, or reassigned), storage is billed at a flat monthly fee per device, with pricing tied to volume. It starts at $35 for a single device.

### What do I get beyond the device itself?
Every order runs on the full quipteams stack: the platform, HRIS integrations, automations, the API, and a network of 400+ local vendors and logistics partners in 155 countries, at no extra cost. There's nothing extra to buy to make it work.

### How does billing work across countries?
You can centralize every purchase, in any country, on one consolidated invoice in USD: no FX fees, no local-currency wires on your side. Local-currency billing is also available in select countries, and payment terms are agreed with your account manager (Net 30 standard).

# Security & Compliance

quipteams (legal entity: QUIPTEAMS INTL SAS) is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified.
- Certificate No. UY 511, issued by FCR Certifica (FCR - Fikley S.A., Montevideo, Uruguay)
- Date of certificate: October 21, 2026. Expiration: October 21, 2029. Audited annually.
- Certified scope: onboarding and offboarding services, warehousing, asset management, buyback, customized universal hardware provisioning, and remote technical services; in-house software development.
- Data encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256)
- Integration credentials stored encrypted and scoped to minimum permissions; quipteams never writes back into the client's HRIS
- SSO via Okta, Google Workspace, and Microsoft
- Secure data wiping with certificates of destruction on every retrieval
- Security questionnaires and the ISO 27001 certificate available on request: andy@quipteams.com

Data handling (from the FAQ): employee data stays in the client's HRIS as the source of truth; quipteams syncs only the fields needed to provision and retrieve equipment (name, email, start/end date, location), encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). Integration credentials are stored encrypted and scoped to minimum permissions. quipteams never writes back into the HRIS; access can be revoked at any time from the dashboard. Stored devices sit in vetted local warehouses with full insurance coverage. Retrievals include certified data wiping with certificates of destruction.

# FAQ
Source: https://www.quipteams.com/faq

### What does quipteams do?
quipteams is an end-to-end IT device lifecycle management solution. Companies can procure, deploy, support, retrieve, store, and resell their devices across 155 countries through local operations, reducing costs and lead times. We work directly with 400+ local vendors and logistics partners in each country to ensure the best SLAs.

### Who uses quipteams?
400+ companies, including Figma, Zoom, Brex, Scale AI, xAI, Revolut, Wise, Mercor, Vercel, Nubank, Webflow, Snap, and Similarweb. Most are fintech, SaaS, and AI companies between 200 and 10,000 employees with teams distributed across multiple countries.

### How much does quipteams cost?
You pay the local device price in each country, plus a per-device fee for operational services like retrieval, storage, or buyback. There are no platform fees, no subscriptions, no per-seat charges, and no minimum orders. The platform itself, the API, integrations, and your account manager are included at zero cost.

### Can I create role-based device kits?
Yes. Admins can build pre-configured kits by role — Developer Kit, Designer Kit, Sales Kit, and so on — with specific devices, peripherals, and accessories. When ordering for a new hire, you select the kit instead of building each order from scratch, and can even pre-approve price ranges.

### What happens if my device breaks?
In the event of an in-transit loss or damage before arrival, quipteams assumes full responsibility and replacement. If a team member happens to break a device, we'll manage warranty handling and repairs for you.

### Where does quipteams store devices?
In local warehouses across 155 countries. Devices stay in the same region where they'll be redeployed, so redeployment is faster and shipping costs are lower than centralizing in one HQ warehouse.

### How much does storage cost?
Storage is free for new devices purchased through quipteams that are waiting to be assigned — there's no time limit. For used devices already in your fleet (retrieved, refreshed, or reassigned), storage is billed at a flat monthly fee per device. Pricing starts at $35 per device per month and gets more efficient at volume.

### Are stored devices secure and insured?
Yes. Devices are stored in vetted local warehouses with full insurance coverage. quipteams is responsible for the safety of every device while in storage.

### How long does retrieval take?
Most pickups are completed within 5–10 business days from the moment the scheduling link is sent. Tracking is visible in the platform from pickup through final destination.

### What devices does quipteams buy back?
Laptops, desktops, tablets, and phones from Apple, Dell, Lenovo, HP, and other major brands. Eligibility depends on model, age, and condition.

### How is the buyback price calculated?
Each device is quoted individually based on model, age, working condition, and current local market value. We provide itemized per-device quotes — not blanket per-unit pricing — so the offer reflects the actual state of each laptop.

### Does quipteams have a public API?
Yes. The public API mirrors our platform. It covers procurement, asset management, and lifecycle workflows. It allows custom integrations with internal tools, ticketing systems, or any HRIS not natively supported.

### What can I do with the quipteams API?
Programmatic access to everything in the platform: create and action quotes, list and manage assets, create device actions (retrievals, transfers, wipes, deployments), add devices to inventory, browse the product and kit catalog, manage webhook subscriptions, and read employee and office data synced from your HRIS. The full API reference lives at https://app.quipteams.com/docs.

### How do I set up API authentication?
Bearer tokens in the Authorization header. Two environments — production and sandbox — so you can test end-to-end before touching real orders. Create keys in company settings: qk_live_… for production, qk_test_… for sandbox. Keys are shown once at creation and can't be retrieved later, so store them securely. Revoke a compromised key instantly from the dashboard.

### What does an HRIS integration actually do for my team?
When a new hire is created or an employee is offboarded in your HRIS, quipteams automatically receives the signal and provisions or retrieves the right equipment — no manual ticket, no CSV upload, no copy-pasting. Equipment is ready before day one, and offboarding retrievals start the moment someone's termination date is set.

### How long does it take to set up an integration?
Most HRIS integrations are live in under 15 minutes from your quipteams dashboard: authorize, select which employee segments to sync, done. Ticketing integrations (Jira, Zendesk, ClickUp) usually take a bit longer because we map statuses and project/board IDs — plan on 30–45 minutes with your admin on the call.

### Does quipteams support SSO?
Yes. Passwordless SSO via Okta, Google Workspace, and Microsoft Entra. Access is role-based with configurable permissions across procurement, asset management, and admin functions.

What does quipteams do?

quipteams is a global device lifecycle platform. We procure, deploy, enroll, retrieve, store, and buy back IT equipment for distributed teams across 155 countries, working directly with a network of 400+ local vendors and logistics partners across those countries instead of routing through regional resellers. 400+ companies — including Figma, Scale AI, Webflow, Wise, Ramp, Revolut, and X — use quipteams to manage devices without juggling multiple vendors per region.

How much does quipteams cost?

quipteams is pay-as-you-go. You pay the local device price in each country and that's it. No platform fees, no subscriptions, no minimum orders, and no exclusivity agreements. Most competitors charge $12,000+/year in management fees on top of device costs; quipteams charges only when you actually order something.

How fast can quipteams deliver devices globally?

The global average is 4 business days from order to delivery. Because devices are sourced locally in each of the 155 countries we cover — not shipped across borders — 80% of orders arrive within 2–4 days.

Which countries does quipteams cover?

quipteams operates in 155 countries across North America, LatAm, EMEA, APAC, and Africa through a direct network of 400+ local vendors and logistics partners. Coverage includes hard-to-serve markets where most competitors rely on third-party resellers.

Can quipteams zero-touch enroll devices (ABM, Intune) before shipping?

Yes. quipteams enrolls Macs in Apple Business Manager (ABM) and PCs in Microsoft Intune before devices ship. Devices arrive pre-enrolled, pre-configured, and ready for day-one use with zero IT intervention required on the employee's end.

What happens when an employee leaves? Can quipteams retrieve the laptop?

Yes. quipteams retrieves devices from departing employees in all 155 countries we cover, including markets where return-label shipping doesn't exist. After pickup, we can wipe the device using certified methods, store it in our local warehouse for the next hire, reassign it to another employee, or buy it back and credit the amount toward future orders. Retrieval is triggered automatically through HRIS sync or manually via the platform.

Does quipteams integrate with my HRIS and tools?

quipteams integrates with Rippling, Workday, BambooHR, HiBob, Deel, Gusto, and other HRIS platforms, plus ticketing tools like Jira and Zendesk. When your HRIS flags a new hire or offboarding, quipteams automatically triggers the procurement or retrieval workflow — no manual data entry. For custom workflows, quipteams provides a public API so you can automate anything your stack needs.

Can I get a quote without talking to sales?

Yes. The quipteams guest platform lets anyone price a device in 155 countries in under 30 seconds, with no account creation, no login, and no sales call required. You pick the country, pick the device, and get itemized pricing including delivery. If you want to place the order, you can do it right there. Try it here .

## Frequently asked questions.
All FAQ

What does quipteams' deployment service include?

quipteams handles every step between purchase and the employee's desk: sourcing the device locally in the destination country, running any imaging steps or enrollment scripts you provide, registering the device in Apple Business Manager or Windows Autopilot so it ties to your MDM on first boot, shipping to the employee's home address on your chosen start date, and ensuring the device arrives ready to log in. The employee unboxes, signs in, and starts working.

How does zero-touch enrollment work through quipteams?

quipteams enrolls devices before they ship. For Apple, this means adding the device to your Apple Business Manager (ABM) tenant and assigning it to your MDM. For Windows, devices are registered in Windows Autopilot and tied to your Microsoft tenant. When the employee powers the laptop on for the first time, it pulls down your configuration automatically — no imaging scripts, no setup sessions, no IT intervention required.

What happens in countries where Apple Business Manager isn't available?

quipteams handles manual enrollment in countries where Apple has no entity or no authorized reseller. This includes extracting hardware hashes, preparing enrollment profiles, and configuring devices so they behave identically to ABM-enrolled units from the employee's perspective.

How long does deployment take?

The global average is 4 business days from order to delivery at the employee's home. Delivery times vary by country and device availability, but because quipteams ships from within the destination country, there are no customs delays or cross-border transit windows. Most LatAm, North America, and Western Europe deliveries land in 2-5 days.

Can I schedule delivery for a specific start date?

Yes. Every order can be scheduled for delivery on or before the employee's first day. quipteams coordinates the shipping timeline based on the start date you set, accounting for local delivery windows and any holidays in the destination country. The employee receives the laptop in time, not weeks later.

How does quipteams handle the employee's address?

You can enter the employee's address directly in the platform, or let quipteams reach out to the employee via email (or SMS/WhatsApp in countries where those are standard) to collect the delivery address and schedule a preferred delivery window.

What if a device arrives damaged or doesn't work?

quipteams handles repair coordination and official warranty claims in every country of operation. If a device fails on arrival, your dedicated account manager arranges a replacement or repair without requiring the employee to ship the device back to you. IT support and warranty handling are included at no extra cost.

Can deployment integrate with our HRIS?

Yes. quipteams integrates with Rippling, Workday, BambooHR, HiBob, and other major HRIS platforms. New hire records sync automatically, which means you can trigger a deployment the moment a candidate is marked "hired" in your HR system — no manual ticket creation, no data re-entry, no missed start dates.

What does deployment cost?

Deployment is included in the cost of the device. There's no separate deployment fee, no per-enrollment charge, and no additional platform cost for zero-touch setup. You pay for the device at local price, deployment is part of the service.

Where does quipteams store devices?

## Frequently asked questions.
All FAQ

How does the quipteams buyback program work?

You select devices from your fleet in the platform — or upload a list if they're not in quipteams yet. We return a per-device quote based on age, model, and condition. Once approved, we coordinate pickup, resell the devices locally, and credit the recovered value to your account. Data wiping can be requested. The credit funds your next purchases. If your account ends with a positive balance, we settle to cash.

What devices does quipteams buy back?

quipteams buys back laptops, desktops, tablets, phones, and select peripherals from major brands including Apple, Dell, Lenovo, HP, and others. Buyback eligibility depends on model, age, and condition.

How is the buyback price calculated?

Each device is quoted individually based on model, age, working condition, and current market value. quipteams provides itemized quotes per device, not blanket per-unit pricing, so the offer reflects the actual state of each laptop.

How does quipteams pay for bought-back devices?

Buyback value is credited to your quipteams account. The credit funds your next device purchases, retrievals, storage, or any other quipteams service. If your account ends with a positive balance — meaning you've sold back more than you've spent — quipteams settles the balance to cash. This avoids invoicing back-and-forth on every transaction and aligns the buyback program with your actual fleet refresh cycle.

Why resell devices instead of shipping them to where they'll be reused?

Most companies try to relocate idle laptops to a country where they have a new hire — but cross-border shipping, customs, and duties on used devices often cost more than the device itself. The reuse plan stalls and the laptop sits in a closet. quipteams flips this: instead of moving the device, quipteams moves the money. The device is sold locally where it was picked up, the recovered value becomes credit in your account, and that credit funds a brand-new device purchased locally in the destination country. The hardware never crosses a border. The value does.

What happens to the data on the device before resale?

Every device is wiped using certified data destruction protocols before resale. The wipe is completed in a quipteams warehouse, not in transit, so there's no window where data is exposed.

When do refresh cycles make sense?

Most clients refresh devices every 3-4 years. Beyond that, employees lose productive time fighting slow machines, security risk increases, and resale value drops sharply. Buyback offsets the cost of the next refresh cycle by recovering capital from outgoing devices.

Is there a minimum number of devices for buyback?

There is no fixed minimum, but the buyback program is most efficient at scale. quipteams quotes single devices and bulk lists alike — the per-device quote logic is the same.

FAQ

## Integrations & API questions
Common questions about our native HRIS integrations and the public API.

Which HRIS and ticketing tools does quipteams integrate with natively?

quipteams has native integrations with BambooHR, HiBob, Rippling, Workday, Deel, Gusto, Namely, Justworks, Personio, Okta, ClickUp, Jira and Zendesk among others — covering most HRIS, SSO and ticketing tools used by distributed teams. New integrations ship regularly.

What does an HRIS integration actually do for my team?

When a new hire is created or an employee is offboarded in your HRIS, quipteams automatically receives the signal and provisions or retrieves the right equipment — no manual ticket, no CSV upload, no copy-pasting. Equipment is ready before day one, and offboarding retrievals start the moment someone's termination date is set.

Is my employee data safe, and where does it live?

Employee data stays in your HRIS as the source of truth. quipteams only syncs the fields needed to provision and retrieve equipment (name, email, start/end date, location) — encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). Integration credentials are stored encrypted and scoped to the minimum permissions required. We never write back into your HRIS, and you can revoke access at any time from your dashboard.

What if my HRIS isn't on the list?

Tell us. We use a unified HRIS layer that lets us add most providers quickly without a custom build on your side. In the meantime, you can manage employees manually from the quipteams dashboard or via the public API — both work without any HRIS connected.

How long does it take to set up an integration?

Most HRIS integrations are live in under 15 minutes from your quipteams dashboard: authorize, select which employee segments to sync, done. Ticketing integrations (Jira, Zendesk, ClickUp) usually take a bit longer because we map statuses and project/board IDs — plan on 30-45 minutes with your admin on the call.

What can I do with the quipteams API?

Programmatic access to everything in the platform: create and action quotes, list and manage assets, create device actions (retrievals, transfers, wipes, deployments), add devices to inventory, browse the product and kit catalog, manage webhook subscriptions, and read employee and office data synced from your HRIS. The full API reference lives at app.quipteams.com/docs.

How do I set up API authentication?

Bearer tokens in the Authorization header. Two environments — production and sandbox — so you can test end-to-end before touching real orders. Create keys in company settings: qk_live_... for production, qk_test_... for sandbox. Keys are shown once at creation and can't be retrieved later, so store them securely. Revoke a compromised key instantly from the dashboard.

Is the API production-ready? What about rate limits?

Yes — it's a stable v1 with 24 endpoints across Quotes, Assets, Device Actions, Devices, Products & Kits, Webhooks, Employees and Offices. Each API key has a per-minute request budget; every response returns X-RateLimit-Limit , X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset headers so you can pace your integration. On 429s we include a Retry-After header.

Can I subscribe to real-time events?

Yes, via webhooks. Register up to 10 webhook endpoints per company, choose the events you care about (tracking updates, delivery status, device action changes), and quipteams sends signed POST requests to your endpoint. You get a signing secret at creation for verification, and there's a test endpoint to confirm your URL is reachable before going live.

Do I need engineering resources to use it?

For HRIS sync and native integrations, no — it's all no-code from the dashboard. For the public API directly, yes: it's a REST API with JSON, Bearer auth and cursor pagination, designed for IT teams with dev capacity or teams using iPaaS tools like Zapier, Make, n8n or Workato. We have a Postman collection so your engineer can be testing calls within 5 minutes.
